description: Defines the google_breakpad::MemoryRange class, a lightweight wrapper for a memory range with helper methods for safe access and subrange extraction.

classes.name: MemoryRange
classes.description: A class encapsulating a contiguous memory range with methods for safe access, subrange extraction, and pointer arithmetic.

methods.name: MemoryRange
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty memory range.

methods.name: MemoryRange
methods.description: Constructor initializing the memory range with a data pointer and length.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the memory range contains no data.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the memory range to an empty state.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the data pointer and length of the memory range.

methods.name: Covers
methods.description: Checks if a subrange specified by offset and length is within the memory range.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a subrange of data, or NULL if out of bounds.

methods.name: GetData (template)
methods.description: Returns a typed pointer to data at a given offset, using sizeof(DataType) for length.

methods.name: GetArrayElement
methods.description: Returns a pointer to an array element at a specified index, or NULL if out of bounds.

methods.name: GetArrayElement (template)
methods.description: Returns a typed pointer to an array element at a specified index.

methods.name: Subrange
methods.description: Returns a subrange of the memory range, or an empty range if out of bounds.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the beginning of the memory range.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the memory range in bytes.
